author: /root/restart_geometric_model
claim: Actual fifth generic norm and regular-function norms on both whole target charts

obligations.name: Hypotheses
obligations.binding: Actual finite dominant map between the proved integral source and target; nonempty normal affine opens and their entire section rings.

obligations.name: Objects
obligations.binding: Original generic stalks, original full-root intermediate field, original eight fixing automorphisms and both whole target charts.

obligations.name: Coverage
obligations.binding: Both full affine target charts, including finite branch values and the chosen zero; no removal to an etale or generic open.

obligations.name: Maps
obligations.binding: Actual generic pullback and actual section map f.app; exact scalar towers proved by generic-germ naturality.

obligations.name: Coefficients
obligations.binding: Original actual field inclusion and relative degree eight, not an independent abstract algebra structure.

obligations.name: Identities
obligations.binding: Original norm product, regular norm generic embedding, pullback eighth power, multiplicativity and preservation of units.

obligations.name: Local/global
obligations.binding: Generic field norm and individual full-chart section norms are proved. Restriction compatibility and all-open sheaf gluing remain separate.

obligations.name: Evidence
obligations.binding: Four bounded strict source checks and fresh target-only recursive audit54; exact predecessor hashes and retained independent finite-rank review.

obligations.name: Boundary
obligations.binding: No Picard/Jacobian norm, polarization, PEL conclusion or independent self-approval. No chosen free basis of section modules is used.
